verdict.rationale: The product documents ways to see installed skills: a desktop Skills sidebar to view skills across projects, a `/skills` command in the CLI and IDE, and a `/plugins` browser. Skills are plain directories under `.agents/skills`, but there is no documented uninstall or remove command and no guarantee of clean removal. Manually deleting folders is a user workaround and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented skill/plugin uninstall command, guarantees of no orphaned files or lingering instructions after removal, a CLI listing of installed items, hands-on corroboration of removal.

support.subject: As a developer, I can list what is installed and remove skills cleanly, without orphaned files or lingering instructions

citations.quote: In the ChatGPT desktop app, open **Skills** in the sidebar to view and explore skills created across your projects.
In Codex CLI or the IDE extension, run `/skills` or type `$` to mention a skill.
In Codex CLI, enter `/plugins` to open the plugin browser.
